english.title: Operator or pilot in command of public transport aircraft carrying unsafely installed equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[operator]_
(B)_[pilot in command]_

of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), in which equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY EQUIPMENT..), was

(C)_[installed]_
(D)_[carried]_

but was not installed, carried, maintained and adjusted so that it did not impair the airworthiness of the aircraft or the proper functioning of any other instrument or equipment necessary for the safety of the aircraft and was not a source of danger to the aircraft
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 119(4A) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation order 2016
